experiments.scope: The exact blake3-r2-prefix-v1 target, root instance of the construction (counter 0, flags 11; proof.md 6.4). One trial of proof.md Section 6.1 per organizer seed, each returning a 55-byte message and a 63-byte message that ends in eight zero bytes: the seven words of a context and the number of a member of the sub-class of Lemma Q2 are taken from the seed, and the pair is built by steps O, M, Y, T, S2 and S3 of Section 4. Every trial is returned. No BLAKE3 library is imported, and the returned pairs are built from the assignments of the quarter-round G and their inverses alone. The same file contains its own 2-round compression (compress2), called only by the self-test, never for a returned pair. SHAKE-256 from the standard library expands the organizer's seed into the trial's parameters. The organizer recomputes both digests. The claim of the package is for the counter instance (proof.md Sections 7 to 11), which no digest experiment can show (6.4); this experiment checks the shared construction only.
experiments.hypothesis: For every trial the two complete 2-round digests agree on digest words 0, 2, 5 and 7, that is on the 128 masked bits, as Lemma T of proof.md Section 6.1 states for every context and every member of the class. This is an exact claim checked on concrete inputs; it is not a test of any heuristic and not evidence of a rate or of attack cost.

experiments.scope: The exact blake3-r2-prefix-v1 target, root instance (counter 0, flags 11). The search of proof.md Section 6 at toy scale: per organizer seed one context, then the members of the sub-class in order from a member number taken from the seed, at most all 131,072 of them, stopping at the first trial whose residual has a zero low byte in digest word 1. Failed trials are returned as null pairs. The number of members tried is returned as the only observation (tries). The counter instance, its filter and its walk are not run; the program's self-test (python3 experiments/halfsearch.py --selftest N [seed], proof.md 9.3) checks the counter construction, the filter for S and the walk of proof.md 9.8 with its unit counts, and the organizer does not run it.
experiments.hypothesis: Every returned pair agrees on 136 digest bits: the 128 bits of the half-collision and the low byte of digest word 1. The experiment checks the trial generator and the residual computation on real digests. The members are tried in order and are not independent trials, so the number of tries is not a measurement of a rate; it is not a test of heuristic H1', H4' or H5' and not evidence of attack cost. Seeds whose context gives no hit within the 131,072 members return null pairs; no number of successes or of tries is predicted, only that the count of successes is at most the trial count.
